title: Satan
definition: Satan is a fallen angel who rebelled against God and now opposes God's purposes through deception, accusation, temptation, and destruction.
summary: Satan is real, created, limited, defeated, and opposed to God and His people.
christFocus: Jesus exposes Satan's lies, defeats his works, and gives abundant life to those who belong to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Satan is not equal with God. He is a created being who rebelled and now opposes God's purposes. Scripture presents him as deceiver, accuser, tempter, destroyer, and adversary.

John 10:10 clearly shows the destructive purpose of the thief: to steal, kill, and destroy. In contrast, Christ came that His people may have life abundantly. Satan's work is destructive; Christ's mission is life-giving.

Though Satan is dangerous, he is limited and defeated. Christ has overcome him through His death and resurrection, and believers resist him by standing firm in faith.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people deny Satan, while others fear him as though he were sovereign. Satan matters because Scripture teaches sober watchfulness without forgetting Christ's victory.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stay alert, resist lies, cling to Scripture, and do not give Satan more attention than Scripture gives him. Fix your confidence on Christ, who gives life and has defeated the evil one.

relatedTopics: God's Protection and Christ's Victory Over Evil
